errors.text_span: Each model category includes a grouped set of three bars representing different SFT training conditions: “no SFT”, “+ SFT on D₀”, “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”. The bars within each model category are arranged adjacently, grouped by SFT condition.
errors.evidence: The bars are stacked, not grouped adjacently. The description incorrectly states 'grouped set of three bars' but there are four bars per model, and they are stacked.

errors.text_span: The “no SFT” bars are colored blue, reaching approximately 65%, 67%, and 71% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: The 'no SFT' bar for LLAMA-2-7B is approximately 66% (not 65%), LLAMA-2-13B is around 70% (not 67%), and LLAMA-2-70B is just above 80% (not 71%).

errors.text_span: The “+ SFT on D₀” bars are colored orange, reaching approximately 67%, 75% and 75% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: The '+ SFT on D₀' bar for LLAMA-2-7B is approximately 66% (not 67%), LLAMA-2-13B is 72% (not 75%), and LLAMA-2-70B is 81% (not 75%).

errors.text_span: The “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bars are colored lavender, reaching approximately 74%, 78% and 79% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively
errors.evidence: The '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' bar for LLAMA-2-7B is around 80% (not 74%), LLAMA-2-13B is approximately 82% (not 78%), and LLAMA-2-70B is around 82% (not 79%). The description also misrepresents the cumulative height of the stacked bars as individual heights.

errors.text_span: and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bars are colored pink and reach approximately 76%, 80% and 80% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: The '+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' bar for LLAMA-2-7B is close to 82% (not 76%), LLAMA-2-13B is about 80% (not 80%, but the cumulative height is correct), and LLAMA-2-70B is close to 80% (not 80%, but the cumulative height is correct). The description misrepresents the cumulative height of the stacked bars as individual heights.

errors.text_span: The “+ SFT on D₀” bars are colored orange

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays model categories labeled “LLaMA-2-7B,” “LLaMA-2-13B,” and “LLaMA-2-70B”, ordered from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.
errors.evidence: The description is unnecessarily verbose in stating 'ordered from left to right' and 'with tick marks at 10-unit intervals,' which are already implied by the axis labels and scale.
